title: Mask Adoption Dynamics in a Population
description: Simulate how mask-wearing behavior spreads and stabilizes in a population under social influence, policy interventions, supply constraints, and evolving epidemic risk.

interactions.name: social_influence_on_adoption
interactions.description: People observe peers' mask use and adjust their own adoption based on social norms, perceived efficacy, and susceptibility to influence.

interactions.name: contact_and_transmission
interactions.description: Co-located individuals interact; infection risk is modulated by mask usage, mask type, contact rate, and ventilation at the location.

interactions.name: policy_enforcement
interactions.description: Authorities set policies for locations and perform inspections; individuals decide to comply or risk penalties.

interactions.name: information_dissemination
interactions.description: Media and public health campaigns broadcast messages that update individuals’ beliefs and perceived risk; misinformation can counteract.

interactions.name: mask_purchase
interactions.description: Individuals buy masks from retailers subject to inventory, prices, subsidies, and personal cost sensitivity.

interactions.name: subsidy_redemption
interactions.description: Individuals redeem subsidies or vouchers to reduce effective mask price at retailers.

metrics.name: overall_mask_adoption_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of individuals wearing any mask during contacts at each time step.

metrics.name: time_to_target_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 70%).

metrics.name: adoption_by_group
metrics.description: Adoption rate stratified by demographic groups (e.g., age, income, education).

metrics.name: adoption_equity_gap
metrics.description: Difference in adoption rates between highest and lowest socioeconomic groups.

metrics.name: mask_quality_mix
metrics.description: Distribution of mask types (cloth, surgical, respirator) among mask wearers.

metrics.name: daily_infection_incidence
metrics.description: Number of new infections per day.

metrics.name: cumulative_infections
metrics.description: Total infections over the simulation horizon.

metrics.name: Rt
metrics.description: Estimated effective reproduction number over time given current behaviors and conditions.

metrics.name: cases_averted_vs_baseline
metrics.description: Difference in cumulative infections versus a no-mask-adoption baseline scenario.

metrics.name: policy_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Share of individuals complying with mask policies when applicable.

metrics.name: enforcement_actions_count
metrics.description: Number of inspections, warnings, or fines issued by authorities.

metrics.name: supply_shortage_days
metrics.description: Number of days retailers have zero inventory for at least one mask type.

metrics.name: average_mask_price
metrics.description: Average retail price paid by individuals for masks over time.

metrics.name: information_reach
metrics.description: Proportion of the population exposed to public health messages or misinformation.
